Welcome

A home among the hills

Misty Dale is a warm, family-run homestay where mornings begin with mist drifting over the valley and evenings end under a sky full of stars.

We rent the property as a whole, so your family or group has the entire home, pool and grounds entirely to itself. Come for a quiet weekend, a celebration or simply some time away.
